_comment: The Way Back's own cards (MAP-10, MAP-12, ENG-38): Fenn Lusk's three, The fair price, and The bridge again (MAP-14). They join the world's deck only while this pack's contract runs. Our own text, CC-BY-4.0, credit 'nat20-table contributors'. Fights use the SRD 5.2.1 Bandit.

cards.text: Rain comes up the river in a grey wall, and the salt sacks on the wagon start to darken at the seams.
cards.text_ru: По реке серой стеной идёт дождь, и мешки с солью на фургоне начинают темнеть по швам.
cards.note: Failure as content: whatever they choose, the contract goes on. Fenn ticks the sacks on his clipboard with the rain running off his nose. Salt melts; a wet Blade only shivers. Bren says salt is Fenn's problem; Maren gives up her cloak first.

choices.text: Throw your cloaks over the sacks.
Pull in under the willows and wait.

cards.text: In the dark two men with a handcart are at the wagon, lifting the iron bars off it one by one, very quietly.
cards.text_ru: В темноте у фургона двое с ручной тележкой: снимают железные прутья один за другим, очень тихо.
cards.note: Two Wendford men with nothing to plough with this spring: the goblins took the oxen and the price of iron went up. Persons, not beasts: they yield the moment they are caught, and a man who drops his bar has yielded. Fights stay a recommendation. Ilsa wants to know whose iron it was before it was Fenn's.

choices.text: Let them go and track them at first light.
choices.text_ru: Дать им уйти и пойти по следу на рассвете.

cards.text: A crowd stands in front of Fenn's wagon on the Wendford green. A woman with a basket says what they all think: salt is dear this year, dearer than anyone remembers, and they want Fenn's salt here, at their price, before it goes up the hill.
cards.text_ru: Перед фургоном Фенна на лугу Вендфорда стоит толпа. Женщина с корзиной говорит то, что думают все: соль в этом году дорогая, дороже, чем кто-либо помнит, и они хотят соль Фенна здесь и по своей цене, пока её не увезли наверх, в холмы.
cards.note: Price is the signal of change, and its cause is off the map: nobody on the green knows why salt is dear, only that it is. Market against custom: Fenn has sold at his price for years, the valley thinks a fair price is the one it always paid, and neither is right. It is Fenn's salt, so Fenn decides with the Blades' advice; he says "Decide it between you" and means it. Nell Hale, the reeve's niece, about eight, sits on the rim of the well with a slate and does the crowd's sums for them, out loud and wrong on purpose. Nobody is hurt: making way means pushing through people, never the wagon over them. If the Blades paid the company's toll at the bridge (paid_the_company), they carry its paper: two silver a head on salt that used to cross for nothing is part of why it is dear, and the crowd can see the seal.

choices.text: Sell the salt at their price.
Show them the receipt for the toll you paid at the bridge.
choices.text_ru: Показать им расписку за пошлину, которую вы заплатили на мосту.

cards.text: Below the ridge a woman in a man's coat stops the wagon. She wants a winter's salt for the farm, and she cannot pay for it until spring. A boy in a bobble hat holds her hand and looks at the horses, not at the salt.
cards.text_ru: Под гребнем фургон останавливает женщина в мужском кафтане. Ей нужна соль на зиму для хутора, а заплатить она сможет только весной. Мальчик в шапке с помпоном держит её за руку и смотрит на лошадей, а не на соль.
cards.note: The farm under the ridge, Col and Dunn's. The goblins took the flock, so there is no wool in spring to pay with, and Fenn won't give credit to a farm with no sheep. If the brothers died at the bridge (killed_col, killed_dunn), she is in black and Fenn knows why; say it plainly. A blind choice and a consequence on the young: what the Blades do here, Gwyn hears by the next contract. Maren speaks first. The boy's look is told as perception, never as a threat.

cards.text: At the Millbeck bridge a painted board hangs on a new post, with a wax seal at the bottom. A man in a clean coat sits under it with a ledger. The toll belongs to a Saltmouth company now, he says: the same two silver a head, written down this time.
cards.text_ru: У моста через Миллбек на новом столбе висит крашеная доска с восковой печатью внизу. Под ней сидит человек в чистом сюртуке с учётной книгой. Пошлина теперь принадлежит солтмутскому товариществу, говорит он: те же два серебряных с головы, только теперь под запись.
cards.note: Before the choices, say in one plain sentence what happened here last time: who held the bridge and what the Blades did about it. Something learned goes out of date: the brothers' false toll is now a true one, on paper, and the paper is Rufus's company's. The clerk is not a villain; he is paid by the day, like the Blades. If the brothers were spared, he has never heard of them. Bren respects a seal; Ilsa asks who gave the company the bridge.

choices.text: Ask him what became of the two brothers.
choices.text_ru: Спросить его, что стало с двумя братьями.

choices.text: Go upstream and ford the beck.
choices.text_ru: Подняться выше по течению и перейти ручей вброд.

cards._comment: The bridge again (MAP-10), an arrival card of the Millbeck bridge (MAP-14): the party meets the clerk when it reaches the bridge, where the text puts him. As a road card of the world's Millbeck zone it was drawn at the end of the bridge road, in Wendford, 8 miles past him; and as a world arrival card it would meet the party on Fair in Wend too, at the same arrival as the bridge's own card. So it lives in The Way Back's deck, which plays only while this contract runs.
